inflation.label: Inflation
inflation.note: Headline CPI, all items, year on year. Food was 19.57% on the same release.

mpr.label: CBN policy rate
mpr.note: The rate the CBN sets. Every other rate here moves with it.

savings.label: Bank savings account
savings.note: The average across Nigerian banks. Yours may differ — check your statement.

tbill.label: Treasury Bill
tbill.note: CBN's money market indicator. Individual auctions can stop at a different rate, and 364-day bills have recently cleared higher.

savingsBond.label: FGN Savings Bond
savingsBond.note: The 3-year tranche of the September offer. The 2-year paid 14.12%. A new rate is set every month.
